test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

The team of scientists were conducting experiments to test its hypothesis.
solution:
The correct answer is: **were conducting**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the given sentence is in the **subject-verb agreement**.
 
• The subject-verb agreement is a grammatical rule that states that the verb in a sentence should agree in number with its subject.
